cover_headline: India's Net GST Collection Jumps 25.6% to Rs 2.03 Trillion in October

end.headline: India's Net GST Collection Jumps 25.6% to Rs 2.03 Trillion in October
end.line: Gross collection rose 22.9% to Rs 2.31 trillion as import-linked tax revenue climbed 42%, according to government data reported on Sunday.

facts: India's net GST collection rose 25.6% year on year to Rs 2.03 trillion ($21.40 billion) in October
Gross collection rose 22.9% to Rs 2.31 trillion, helped by a 42% jump in tax revenue from imports to Rs 72,246 crore
October was the fourth month of this financial year in which gross GST crossed Rs 2 trillion
